Best subset selection

Source: R/resampling.R
best_subset.Rd

Fits every subset of the fixed effect terms of one parameter (keeping random effects) and ranks them by AIC, AICc, BIC or the Hannan-Quinn criterion. Practical for up to about 15 candidate terms.

Usage

best_subset(
  object,
  scope = NULL,
  criterion = c("AIC", "AICc", "BIC", "HQ"),
  par = NULL,
  top = 5
)

Arguments

object

A fitted model.

scope

Optional one sided formula of candidate terms (default the terms of the fit).

criterion

"AIC", "AICc", "BIC" or "HQ".

par

Parameter whose formula is searched (default the first).

top

Number of best models to return.

Value

A data frame of the best models (terms, criterion, df), with the best fit as attribute "fit".

Examples

d <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(80), x2 = rnorm(80), x3 = rnorm(80))
d$y <- rpois(80, exp(0.5 + 0.4 * d$x1))
best_subset(regcomp(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, family = "poisson", data = d), criterion = "BIC")
#>          terms      BIC df
#> 1           x1 257.7691  2
#> 2      x1 + x2 260.2847  3
#> 3      x1 + x3 261.6825  3
#> 4 x1 + x2 + x3 264.2270  4
#> 5       (none) 278.3815  1
